correctness.rationale: PASS: From Tallini/Homma–Kim vanishing ideal generated by U,V,W in degree q+1, all such curves are G_a=det(a,X,X^q). Differentiating gives grad_X G_a=a×X^q and a unique geometric critical point a^(1/q). Projective local expansion yields tangent cone a q-th power of a line when r(a)>1; linear-factor coefficient comparison shows every line component must be an Fq-line through a, giving q+1,1,0 line components according to ranks 1,2,3. Bezout plus unique singular point excludes hidden factors, projection from the degree−1 multiplicity point gives rational normalization and genus/δ; branch tangent contact gives unibranch cases. Point counts follow from rational normalizations and single rational cusp/meeting point, and Moore determinant polar is a Frobenius qth power of G_a. The source exact finite-field verifier for q=2,3 was inspected; it cannot substitute for general proof.
